title: Pokémon Go Tour in Nashville by Golf Cart
includes: Children age 4 and under are not allowed. Children ages 5-8 MUST be in booster or car seat! (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Our tours operate rain or shine, hot or cold. Please dress for the weather!
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Pokémon GO! Catch Pokémon, visit Poké Stops, battle at Gyms, and tour Nashville. Comes with your personal safety officer (driver/tour guide) for you and your group.  Not only will you get to chase your favorite Poke'mon character.  You will get to see Nashville at the same time!
